It reproduces this file's empty `kept` rather than undoing the correction, and it raises afterwards because no region qualifies -- which is the finding, not a failure. Two fixes made it safe, both previously required to be understood by hand: gt_prep_fragment now honours the shared retired-non-scoring list (repro/sota_data/retirement.py), so 20230702185753 no longer returns passed:true by clearing the 48 px gate at 46.6 px; and cmd_prep now carries this `superseded` block forward instead of overwriting it. NOTE the live placement for 20231005123336_y4000_x2500 measures 57.5 px here; that discrepancy against the 55.1 px originally recorded in registration_offset_2026-08-07.md is now explained and resolved in favour of this file -- the 55.1 px was a hand-run figure no committed path reproduces, and 57.5 px is what committed code produces at default parameters. The peak is broad, so the offset is determined to about +/- 1 px (56.5 to 57.5 px across search windows) rather than to three significant figures. The 08-07 report has been corrected to 57.5 px; both figures are well over the 48 px gate, so the exclusion never depended on it.
